verdict.rationale: Browserbase's fetch capability converts any URL into markdown or JSON for agent context [docs-3]. It runs real browser sessions with auto-waits that handle rendering [docs-1, docs-4]. It also claims to handle CAPTCHAs and login walls, which covers blocking [docs-8, docs-10]. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the markdown/text extraction quality and how it is cleaned, specifics on how the fetch API handles blocking and rendering, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is homepage-level marketing).
